mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving the S&P 500 forward returns negatively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last quarter indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where real GDP increased, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in the last two months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate output and earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in the last two months indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals an inflationary environment with tightening monetary policy, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the last month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP and an increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signal a weakening economy, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decrease and UNRATE increase > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, this hypothesis is rejected.
